51549077.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to ENL YEATS domain (unknown origin) at 100 uM by ITC analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - ITC: All ITC experiments were conducted in a Microcal AutoITC (Malvern). The cell temperature was kept at 25 °C and a total of 19 injections of 2 μL were performed during 4 seconds with a spacing time of 150 sec. Blanks of heat of dilution of the compounds have been subtracted in all the experiments. The data was analyzed using Affinimeter software and fitted to a simple 1:1 model. The protein sample was dialyzed on ITC buffer (20 mM HEPES 7.5; 200 mM KCl; 1 mM TCEP). The protein was used at 10 μM final concentration and compounds at 100 μM in the dialysis buffer supplemented with 0.01% tween 20 + 1% DMSO.
original_paragraph.Figure S5 caption: Figure S5. ITC curves for representative compounds One of two independent replicates is shown.
